verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              ततः श्वेताश्वसंयुक्ते नारायणसमाहिते । तिष्ठन्रथवरे श्रीमानर्जुनः समपद्यत ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Then on that best of cars drawn by white horses and driven by Narayana himself the beautiful Arjuna arrived there.

verses.sanskrit: तद्बलं नृपतिश्रेष्ठ तावकं विजयो रणे । व्यक्षोभयदुदीर्णाश्वं महोदधिमिवानिलः ॥२॥
verses.english: As the wind agitates a great ocean so Vijaya overpowered your army, O foremost of kings, abounding in horse-men.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनस्तव सुतः प्रमत्ते श्वेतवाहने । अभ्येत्य सहसा क्रुद्धः सैन्यार्धेनाभिसंवृतः ॥३॥
verses.english: While (Arjuna) the rider of white horses was a little careless your son Duryodhana, worked up with anger and surrounded by his soldiers, came there all on sudden and encompassed the revengeful Yudhishthira. He then struck Yudhishthira with seventy-three razor-shaped arrows.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यवारयदायान्तं युधिष्ठिरममर्षणम् । क्षुरप्राणां त्रिसप्तत्या ततोऽविध्यत पाण्डवम् ॥४॥
अक्रुध्यत भृशं तत्र कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः । स भल्लांस्त्रिशतस्तूर्णं तव पुत्रे न्यवेशयत् ॥५॥
verses.english: At that Kunti's son Yudhishthira was greatly worked up with anger. He quickly struck your son with thirty darts.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽधावन्त कौरव्या जिघृक्षन्तो युधिष्ठिरम् । दुष्टभावान्पराञ्ज्ञात्वा समवेता महारथाः ॥६॥
verses.english: Then the Kuru soldiers rushed against Yudhishthira for seized him. Then apprised of the evil intention of the enemies the great carwarriors came there in a body for rescuing Kunti's son Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: आजग्मुस्तं परीप्सन्तः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् । नकुलः सहदेवश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः ॥७॥
verses.english: Encircled by an Akshauhini of soldiers Nakula, Sahadeva, Dhristadyumna and Parshata advanced towards Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षौहिण्या परिवृतास्तेऽभ्यधावन् युधिष्ठिरम् । भीमसेनश्च समरे मृद्नंस्तव महारथान् ॥८॥
अभ्यधावदभिप्रेप्सू राजानं शत्रुभिर्वृतम् । तांस्तु सर्वान्महेष्वासान्कर्णो वैकर्तनो नृप ॥९॥
verses.english: Grinding the great car-warriors your army Bhimasena too went where Yudhishthira was surrounded by his enemies.

verses.sanskrit: शरवर्षेण महता प्रत्यवारयदागतान् । शरौघान्विसृजन्तस्ते प्रेरयन्तश्च तोमरान् ॥१०॥
verses.english: Making a downpour of arrows, O king, Vikartana's son Karna obstructed alone all those great bowmen.

verses.sanskrit: न शेकुर्यत्नवन्तोऽपि राधेयं प्रतिवीक्षितुम् । तांश्च सर्वान्महेष्वासान्सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रपारगः ॥११॥
verses.english: Although making a downpour of arrows, discharging Tomaras and exerting their very best they could not look at the son of Radha.

verses.sanskrit: महता शरवर्षेण राधेयः प्रत्यवारयत् । दुर्योधनं च विंशत्या शीघ्रमस्त्रमुदीरयन् ॥१२॥
verses.english: With a huge downpour of arrows the son of Radha who had mastered all sorts of weapons withstood all those great bow men.

verses.sanskrit: अविध्यत्तूर्णमभ्येत्य सहदेवः प्रतापवान् । स विद्धः सहदेवेन रराजाचलसन्निभः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Taking up speedily his bow the nobleminded Sahadeva soon approached Duryodhana and struck him with twenty arrows.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभिन्न इव मातङ्गो रुधिरेण परिप्लुतः । दृष्ट्वा तव सुतं तत्र गाढविद्धं सुतेजनैः ॥१४॥
verses.english: Struck by Sahadeva Duryodhana, huge like a mountain, covered with blood, appeared like a maimed elephant.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यधावद्दृढं क्रुद्धो राधेयो रथिनां वरः । दुर्योधनं तथा दृष्ट्वा शीघ्रमस्त्रमुदैरयत् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Seeing you son sorely wounded with many powerful shafts Karna, the best of car-warriors, worth proceeded there.

verses.sanskrit: तेन यौधिष्ठिरं सैन्यमवधीत्पार्षतं तथा । ततो यौधिष्ठिरं सैन्यं वध्यमानं महात्मना ॥१६॥
verses.english: Beholding Duryodhana in that condition and quickly getting ready his weapon he soon struck the sons of Yudhishthira and Prishata.

verses.sanskrit: सहसा प्राद्रवद्राजन् सुतपुत्रशरार्दितम् । विविधा विशिखास्तत्र संपतन्तः परस्परम् ॥१७॥
verses.english: Assailed with arrows by the great son of the charioteer Yudhishthira's soldiers all on a sudden fled away.

verses.sanskrit: फलैः पुंखान्समाजग्मुः सूतपुत्रधनुश्च्युताः । अन्तरिक्षे शरौघाणां पततां च परस्परम् ॥१८॥
verses.english: Various sorts of arrows fell there touching one another. Those, shot off the bow of Karna, touched the wings of others with their blades.

verses.sanskrit: संघर्षेण महाराज पावकः समजायत । ततो दश दिशः कर्णः शलभैरिव यायिभिः ॥१९॥
verses.english: The arrows coming in contact with one another a conflagration was caused in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यघ्नंस्तरसा राजञ्शरैः परशरीरगैः । रक्तचन्दनसन्दिग्धौ मणिहेमविभूषितौ ॥२०॥
verses.english: With arrows capable of piercing the bodies of the enemies and advancing quickly Karna covered the ten quarters as if with a swarm of locusts.

verses.sanskrit: बाहू व्यत्यक्षिपत्कर्णः परमास्त्रं विदर्शयन् । ततः सर्वा दिशो राजन्सायकैर्विप्रमोहयन् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Beautiful bows shone in the arms of Karna of the colour of crimson sandal and adorned with gold and jewels.

verses.sanskrit: अपीडयद्भृशं कर्णो धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम् । ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Then all the quarters were shrouded with arrows. And Karna greatly assailed the righteous king Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: निशितैरिषुभिः कर्णं पञ्चाशद्भिः समार्पयत् । बाणान्धकारमभवत्तद्युद्धं घोरदर्शनम् ॥२३॥
verses.english: Then worked up with anger Kunti's son king Yudhishthira struck Karna with fifty sharpened arrows.

verses.sanskrit: हाहाकारो महानासीत्तावकानां विशांपते । वध्यमाने तदा सैन्ये धर्मपुत्रेण मारिष ॥२४॥
verses.english: Darkened with arrows that army looked exceedingly dreadful. And your soldiers, O king, sent up piteous wails of pain.

verses.sanskrit: सायकैर्विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैः कङ्कपत्रैः शिलाशितैः । भल्लैरनेकैर्विविधैः शक्त्यृष्टिमुसलैरपि ॥२५॥
verses.english: While they were being slain by Dharma's son with various sharp Kanka-feathered arrows whetted on stone, Bhallas, Saktis and clubs. Wherever the virtuous king extended his looks all the soldiers of your party were shattered.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र यत्र स धर्मात्मा दुष्टां दृष्टिं व्यसर्जयत् । तत्र तत्र व्यशीर्यन्त तावका भरतर्षभ ॥२६॥
कर्णोऽपि भृशसंक्रुद्धो धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम् । नाराचैरर्धचन्द्रैश्च वत्सदन्तैश्च संयुगे ॥२७॥
verses.english: Then Karna, greatly worked up with anger, struck Yudhishthira with winged and calf-tooth shaped arrows. Revengeful, wrathful and having his lips trembling in anger the highly energetic Karna struck Yudhishthira with arrows.

verses.sanskrit: अमर्षी क्रोधनश्चैव रोषप्रस्फुरिताननः । सायकैरप्रमेयात्मा युधिष्ठिरमभिद्रवत् ॥२८॥
युधिष्ठिरश्चापि स तं स्वर्णपुङ्खैः शितैः शरैः । प्रहसन्निव तं कर्णः कङ्कपत्रैः शिलाशितैः ॥२९॥
verses.english: Then worked up with anger Karna grasped his bow very strongly and struck Bhima with ten Kanka-feathered arrows whetted on stone. With another sharp Bhalla he cut-off Bhima's bow.

verses.sanskrit: उरस्यविध्यद्राजानं त्रिभिर्भल्लैश्च पाण्डवम् । स पीडितो भृशं तेन धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ॥३०॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira too struck him with gold feathered and sharpened arrows. Karna, as if smiling, struck the Pandava king on the breast with three winged darts.

verses.sanskrit: उपविश्य रथोपस्थे सूतं याहीत्यचोदयत् । अक्रोशन्त ततः सर्वे धार्तराष्ट्राः सराजकाः ॥३१॥
verses.english: Thus greatly assailed by him the pious king Yudhishthira sat down on his car and ordered his charioteer to go.

verses.sanskrit: गृह्णीध्वमिति राजानमभ्यधावन्त सर्वशः । ततः शताः सप्तदश केकयानां प्रहारिणाम् ॥३२॥
verses.english: Then all the soldiers of your army with their king sent up a loud war-cry saying-"seize him" and then they rushed towards the king.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालैः सहिता राजन् धार्तराष्ट्रान्न्यवारयन् । तस्मिन् सुतुमुले युद्धे वर्तमाने जनक्षये ॥३३॥
verses.english: Then seventeen hundred Kekaya warriors with Panchalas obstructed the soldiers of Duryodhana.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनश्च भीमश्च समेयातां महाबलौ ॥३४॥
verses.english: When that dreadful and destructive battle raged on the highly powerful Duryodhana and Bhima fought with each other.
